ayahs.1: Alif Laam Ra, yeh ek aisi kitaab hai ke is ki aayaten mohkam ki gayi hain, phir saaf saaf bayan ki gayi hain ek hakeem ba-khabar ki taraf se.
ayahs.2: Yeh ke Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibaadat mat karo, main tum ko Allah ki taraf se daraane wala aur bushaarat dene wala hoon.
ayahs.3: Aur yeh ke tum log apne gunaah apne Rabb se maaf karao phir usi ki taraf mutawajjeh raho, woh tum ko waqt-e-muqarrar tak achcha saamaan (zindagi) dega aur har ziyada amal karne wale ko ziyada sawaab dega. Aur agar tum log eraaz karte rahe to mujh ko tumhare liye ek bade din ke azaab ka andesha hai.
ayahs.4: Tum ko Allah hi ke paas jana hai aur woh har shai par poori qudrat rakhta hai.
ayahs.5: Yaad rakho woh log apne seenon ko dohra kiye dete hain taake apni baaten (Allah) se chhupa saken. Yaad rakho ke woh log jis waqt apne kapde lapetate hain, woh us waqt bhi sab jaanta hai jo kuchh chhupate hain aur jo kuchh woh zaahir karte hain. Bilyaqeen woh dilon ke andar ki baaten jaanta hai.
ayahs.6: Zameen par chalne phirne wale jitne jaandar hain sab ki roziyan Allah Taala par hain, wahi un ke rehne sehne ki jagah ko jaanta hai aur un ke saumpe jaane ki jagah ko bhi, sab kuchh waazeh kitaab mein maujood hai.
ayahs.7: Allah hi woh hai jis ne chhe din mein aasman-o-zameen ko paida kiya aur us ka arsh paani par tha taake woh tumhein aazmaaye ke tum mein se achche amal wala kaun hai, agar aap in se kahen ke tum log marne ke baad utha khade kiye jaoge to kaafir log palat kar jawab denge ke yeh to nira saaf saaf jaadu hi hai.
ayahs.8: Aur agar hum in se azaab ko gini chuni muddat tak ke liye peechhe daal den to yeh zaroor pukar uthenge ke azaab ko kaun si cheez roke hue hai, suno! Jis din woh un ke paas aayega phir un se talne wala nahin, phir to jis cheez ki hansi uda rahe the woh unhen gher legi.
ayahs.9: Aur agar hum insan ko apni kisi nemat ka zaaiqa chakha kar phir use us se le len to woh bahut hi na-umeed aur bada hi na-shukra ban jaata hai.
ayahs.10: Aur agar hum use koi nemat chakhaayen us sakhti ke baad jo use pahunch chuki thi to woh kehne lagta hai ke bas buraiyan mujh se jaati rahin, yaqeenan woh bada hi itraane wala sheikhi-khor hai.
ayahs.11: Siwaye un ke jo sabr karte hain aur nek kaamon mein lage rehte hain. Inhi logon ke liye bakhshish bhi hai aur bahut bada nek badla bhi.
ayahs.12: Pas shaayad ke aap is wahi ke kisi hisse ko chhod dene wale hain jo aap ki taraf naazil ki jaati hai aur is se aap ka dil tang hai, sirf un ki is baat par ke is par koi khazana kyun nahin utra? Ya is ke saath koi farishta hi aata, sun lijiye! Aap to sirf daraane wale hi hain aur har cheez ka zimma-daar Allah Taala hai.
ayahs.13: Kya yeh kehte hain ke is Quran ko usi ne ghada hai. Jawab dijiye ke phir tum bhi isi ki misl das surtein ghadi hui le aao aur Allah ke siwa jise chaho apne saath bula bhi lo agar tum sachche ho.
ayahs.14: Phir agar woh tumhari is baat ko qabool na karen to tum yaqeen se jaan lo ke yeh Quran Allah ke ilm ke saath utaara gaya hai aur yeh ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin, pas kya tum musalmaan hote ho?
ayahs.15: Jo shakhs dunya ki zindagi aur is ki zeenat par farefta hua chahta ho, hum aison ko un ke kull aamaal (ka badla) yahin bharpoor pahuncha dete hain aur yahan unhen koi kami nahin ki jaati.
ayahs.16: Haan yehi woh log hain jin ke liye aakhirat mein siwaye aag ke aur kuchh nahin aur jo kuchh unhon ne yahan kiya hoga wahan sab akarat hai aur jo kuchh un ke aamaal the sab barbaad hone wale hain.
ayahs.17: Kya woh shakhs jo apne Rabb ke paas ki daleel par ho aur us ke saath Allah ki taraf ka gawah ho aur us se pehle Moosa ki kitaab (gawah ho) jo peshwa aur rahmat hai (auron ke baraabar ho sakta hai?) Yehi log hain jo is par imaan rakhte hain, aur tamaam firqon mein se jo bhi is ka munkir ho us ke aakhri wade ki jagah jahannam hai, pas tu is mein kisi qisam ke shubha mein na reh, yaqeenan yeh tere Rabb ki jaanib se sarasar barhaq hai, lekin aksar log imaan laane wale nahin hote.
ayahs.18: Is se badh kar zaalim kaun hoga jo Allah par jhoot baandhe, yeh log apne parwardigar ke saamne pesh kiye jaayenge aur saare gawah kahenge ke yeh woh log hain jinhon ne apne parwardigar par jhoot baandha, khabardaar ho ke Allah ki lanat hai zaalimon par.
ayahs.19: Jo Allah ki raah se rokte hain aur is mein kaji talaash kar lete hain. Yehi aakhirat ke munkir hain.
ayahs.20: Na yeh log dunya mein Allah ko hara sake aur na un ka koi himayati Allah ke siwa hua, un ke liye azaab dugna kiya jaayega, na yeh sunne ki taaqat rakhte the aur na yeh dekhte hi the.
ayahs.21: Yehi hain jinhon ne apna nuqsaan aap kar liya aur woh sab kuchh un se kho gaya, jo unhon ne ghad rakha tha.
ayahs.22: Beshak yehi log aakhirat mein ziyan-kaar honge.
ayahs.23: Yaqeenan jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne kaam bhi nek kiye aur apne paalne wale ki taraf jhukte rahe, wahi jannat mein jaane wale hain, jahan woh hamesha hi rehne wale hain.
ayahs.24: In donon firqon ki misaal andhe, behre aur dekhne, sunne wale jaisi hai. Kya yeh donon misaal mein baraabar hain? Kya phir bhi tum naseehat haasil nahin karte?
ayahs.25: Yaqeenan hum ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ko is ki qaum ki taraf Rasool bana kar bheja ke main tumhein saaf saaf hoshiyaar kar dene wala hoon.
ayahs.26: Ke tum sirf Allah hi ki ibaadat karo, mujhe to tum par dardnaak din ke azaab ka khauf hai.
ayahs.27: Us ki qaum ke kaafiron ke sardaron ne jawab diya ke hum to tujhe apne jaisa insan hi dekhte hain aur tere tabedaron ko bhi hum dekhte hain ke yeh log waazeh taur par siwaye neech logon ke aur koi nahin jo be-soche samjhe (tumhari pairwi kar rahe hain), hum to tumhari kisi qisam ki bartari apne oopar nahin dekh rahe, balke hum to tumhein jhoota samajh rahe hain.
ayahs.28: Nooh ne kaha, meri qaum walo! Mujhe batao to agar main apne Rabb ki taraf se kisi daleel par hua aur mujhe us ne apne paas ki koi rahmat ata ki ho, phir woh tumhari nigahon mein na aayi to kya zabardasti main use tumhare gale mandh doon, halaanke tum us se bezaar ho.
ayahs.29: Meri qaum walo! Main tum se is par koi maal nahin maangta. Mera sawaab to sirf Allah Taala ke haan hai, na main imaan walon ko apne paas se nikaal sakta hoon, unhen apne Rabb se milna hai lekin main dekhta hoon ke tum log jahaalat kar rahe ho.
ayahs.30: Meri qaum ke logo! Agar main in momino ko apne paas se nikaal doon to Allah ke muqabla mein meri madad kaun kar sakta hai? Kya tum kuchh bhi naseehat nahin pakadte.
ayahs.31: Main tum se nahin kehta ke mere paas Allah ke khazane hain, (suno!) main ghaib ka ilm bhi nahin rakhta, na main yeh kehta hoon ke main koi farishta hoon, na mera yeh qaul hai ke jin par tumhari nigahen zillat se pad rahi hain unhen Allah Taala koi nemat dega hi nahin, un ke dil mein jo hai use Allah hi khoob jaanta hai, agar main aisi baat kahoon to yaqeenan mera shumaar zaalimon mein ho jaayega.
ayahs.32: (Qaum ke logon ne) kaha aye Nooh! Tu ne hum se behas kar li aur khoob behas kar li. Ab to jis cheez se hamein dhamka raha hai wahi hamare paas le aa, agar tu sachchon mein hai.
ayahs.33: Jawab diya ke use bhi Allah Taala hi laayega agar woh chahe aur haan tum use haraane wale nahin ho.
ayahs.34: Tumhein meri khair-khwahi kuchh bhi nafa nahin de sakti, go main kitni hi tumhari khair-khwahi kyun na chahoon, bashart-ke Allah ka irada tumhein gumraah karne ka ho, wahi tum sab ka parwardigar hai aur usi ki taraf lautaaye jaoge.
ayahs.35: Kya yeh kehte hain ke use khud usi ne ghad liya hai? To jawab de ke agar main ne use ghad liya ho to mera gunaah mujh par hai aur main un gunahon se bari hoon jo tum kar rahe ho.
ayahs.36: Nooh ki taraf wahi bheji gayi ke teri qaum mein se jo imaan la chuke un ke siwa aur koi ab imaan laayega hi nahin, pas tu un ke kaamon par ghamgeen na ho.
ayahs.37: Aur ek kashti hamari aankhon ke saamne aur hamari wahi se taiyaar kar aur zaalimon ke baare mein hum se koi baat cheet na kar, woh paani mein dubo diye jaane wale hain.
ayahs.38: Woh (Nooh) kashti banane lage, un ki qaum ke jo sardaar un ke paas se guzarte woh un ka mazaaq udaate, woh kehte agar tum hamara mazaaq udaate ho to hum bhi tum par ek din hansenge jaise tum hum par hanste ho.
ayahs.39: Tumhein bahut jald maloom ho jaayega ke kis par azaab aata hai jo use ruswa kare aur us par hameshgi ki saza utar aaye.
ayahs.40: Yahan tak ke jab hamara hukm aa pahuncha aur tanoor ubalne laga hum ne kaha ke is kashti mein har qisam ke (jaandaron mein se) jode (yani) do (jaanwar, ek nar aur ek maada) sawaar kara le aur apne ghar ke logon ko bhi, siwaye un ke jin par pehle se baat pad chuki hai aur sab imaan walon ko bhi, is ke saath imaan laane wale bahut hi kam the.
ayahs.41: Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha, is kashti mein baith jao, Allah hi ke naam se is ka chalna aur thehrna hai, yaqeenan mera Rabb badi bakhshish aur bade rahm wala hai.
ayahs.42: Woh kashti unhen pahaadon jaisi maujon mein le kar ja rahi thi aur Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne apne ladke ko jo ek kinare par tha, pukar kar kaha ke aye mere pyare bachche hamare saath sawaar ho ja aur kaafiron mein shaamil na reh.
ayahs.43: Us ne jawab diya ke main to kisi bade pahaad ki taraf panah mein aa jaunga jo mujhe paani se bacha lega, Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha aaj Allah ke amr se bachaane wala koi nahin, sirf wahi bachenge jin par Allah ka rahm hua. Usi waqt in donon ke darmiyan mauj haail ho gayi aur woh dubne walon mein se ho gaya.
ayahs.44: Farma diya gaya ke aye zameen apne paani ko nigal ja aur aye aasman bas kar tham ja, usi waqt paani sukha diya gaya aur kaam poora kar diya gaya aur kashti Judi naami pahaad par ja lagi aur farma diya gaya ke zaalim logon par lanat naazil ho.
ayahs.45: Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne apne parwardigar ko pukara aur kaha ke mere Rabb mera beta to mere ghar walon mein se hai, yaqeenan tera wada bilkul sachcha hai aur tu tamaam haakimon se behtar haakim hai.
ayahs.46: Allah Taala ne farmaya aye Nooh yaqeenan woh tere gharaane se nahin hai, is ke kaam bilkul hi nashaista hain, tujhe hargiz woh cheez na maangni chahiye jis ka tujhe mutlaqan ilm na ho, main tujhe naseehat karta hoon ke tu jaahilon mein se apna shumaar karaane se baaz rahe.
ayahs.47: Nooh ne kaha mere paalanhaar main teri hi panah chahta hoon is baat se ke tujh se woh maangoon jis ka mujhe ilm hi na ho, agar tu mujhe na bakhshega aur tu mujh par rahm na farmaayega, to main khasaara paane walon mein ho jaunga.
ayahs.48: Farma diya gaya ke aye Nooh! Hamari jaanib se salaamati aur un barkaton ke saath utar, jo tujh par hain aur tere saath ki bahut si jamaaton par aur bahut si woh ummaten hongi jinhen hum faaida to zaroor pahunchaayenge lekin phir unhen hamari taraf se dardnaak azaab pahunchega.
ayahs.49: Yeh khabren ghaib ki khabron mein se hain jin ki wahi hum aap ki taraf karte hain, inhen is se pehle na aap jaante the aur na aap ki qaum, is liye aap sabr karte rahiye (yaqeen maaniye) ke anjaam-kaar parhezgaron ke liye hi hai.
ayahs.50: Aur qaum-e-Aad ki taraf un ke bhai Hood ko hum ne bheja, us ne kaha meri qaum walo! Allah hi ki ibaadat karo, is ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin, tum to sirf bohtan baandh rahe ho.
ayahs.51: Aye meri qaum! Main tum se is ki koi ujrat nahin maangta, mera ajr us ke zimme hai jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai, to kya phir bhi tum aqal se kaam nahin lete.
ayahs.52: Aye meri qaum ke logo! Tum apne paalne wale se apni taqseeron ki maafi talab karo aur us ki janaab mein tauba karo, taake woh barasne wale baadal tum par bhej de aur tumhari taaqat par aur taaqat-o-quwwat badha de aur tum jurm karte hue rogardaani na karo.
ayahs.53: Unhon ne kaha aye Hood! Tu hamare paas koi daleel to laaya nahin aur hum sirf tere kehne se apne mabudon ko chhodne wale nahin aur na hum tujh par imaan laane wale hain.
ayahs.54: Balke hum to yehi kehte hain ke tu hamare kisi mabood ke bure jhapte mein aa gaya hai. Us ne jawab diya ke main Allah ko gawah karta hoon aur tum bhi gawah raho ke main to Allah ke siwa in sab se bezaar hoon, jinhen tum shareek bana rahe ho.
ayahs.55: Achcha tum sab mil kar mere khilaaf chaalen chal lo aur mujhe bilkul mohlat bhi na do.
ayahs.56: Mera bharosa sirf Allah Taala par hi hai, jo mera aur tum sab ka parwardigar hai, jitne bhi paon dharne wale hain sab ki peshaani wahi thaame hue hai. Yaqeenan mera Rabb bilkul saheeh raah par hai.
ayahs.57: Pas agar tum rogardaani karo to karo, main to tumhein woh paighaam pahuncha chuka jo de kar mujhe tumhari taraf bheja gaya tha. Mera Rabb tumhare qaim-maqaam aur logon ko kar dega aur tum is ka kuchh bhi bigaad na sakoge, yaqeenan mera parwardigar har cheez par nigehbaan hai.
ayahs.58: Aur jab hamara hukm aa pahuncha to hum ne Hood ko aur is ke musalmaan saathiyon ko apni khaas rahmat se najaat ata farmaayi aur hum ne un sab ko sakht azaab se bacha liya.
ayahs.59: Yeh thi qaum-e-Aad, jinhon ne apne Rabb ki aayaton ka inkaar kiya aur is ke Rasoolon ki nafarmaani ki aur har ek sarkash nafarmaan ke hukm ki tabedaari ki.
ayahs.60: Dunya mein bhi un ke peechhe lanat laga di gayi aur qayamat ke din bhi, dekh lo qaum-e-Aad ne apne Rabb se kufr kiya, Hood ki qaum Aad par doori ho.
ayahs.61: Aur qaum-e-Samood ki taraf un ke bhai Saleh ko bheja, us ne kaha ke aye meri qaum tum Allah ki ibaadat karo is ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin, usi ne tumhein zameen se paida kiya hai aur usi ne is zameen mein tumhein basaaya hai, pas tum is se maafi talab karo aur is ki taraf rujoo karo. Beshak mera Rabb qareeb aur duaon ka qabool karne wala hai.
ayahs.62: Unhon ne kaha aye Saleh! Is se pehle to hum tujh se bahut kuchh ummeeden lagaaye hue the, kya tu hamein un ki ibaadaton se rok raha hai jin ki ibaadat hamare baap dada karte chale aaye, hamein to is deen mein hairaan-kun shak hai jis ki taraf tu hamein bula raha hai.
ayahs.63: Us ne jawab diya ke aye meri qaum ke logo! Zara batao to agar main apne Rabb ki taraf se kisi mazboot daleel par hua aur us ne mujhe apne paas ki rahmat ata ki ho, phir agar main ne is ki nafarmaani kar li to kaun hai jo is ke muqable mein meri madad kare? Tum to mera nuqsaan hi badha rahe ho.
ayahs.64: Aur aye meri qaum walo! Yeh Allah ki bheji hui ontni hai jo tumhare liye ek mojiza hai, ab tum use Allah ki zameen mein khaati hui chhod do aur use kisi tarah ki eeza na pahunchao warna ek qareeb azaab tumhein pakad lega.
ayahs.65: Phir bhi in logon ne is ontni ke paon kaat daale, is par Saleh ne kaha ke achcha tum apne gharon mein teen teen din tak to reh saha lo, yeh wada jhoota nahin hai.
ayahs.66: Phir jab hamara farmaan aa pahuncha, hum ne Saleh ko aur un par imaan laane walon ko apni rahmat se is se bhi bacha liya aur is din ki ruswayi se bhi. Yaqeenan tera Rabb nihaayat tawaana aur ghaalib hai.
ayahs.67: Aur zaalimon ko bade zor ki chinghaad ne aa dabocha, phir to woh apne gharon mein aundhe pade hue reh gaye.
ayahs.68: Aise ke goya woh wahan kabhi aabaad hi na the, aagah raho ke qaum-e-Samood ne apne Rabb se kufr kiya. Sun lo! Un Samoodiyon par phitkaar hai.
ayahs.69: Aur hamare bheje hue paighaambar Ibraheem ke paas khushkhabri le kar pahunche aur salaam kaha, unhon ne bhi jawab-e-salaam diya aur baghair kisi taakheer ke gaay ka bhuna hua bachhda le aaye.
ayahs.70: Ab jo dekha ke un ke to haath bhi is ki taraf nahin pahunch rahe to un se ajnabiyat mahsoos karke dil hi dil mein un se khauf karne lage, unhon ne kaha daro nahin, hum to qaum-e-Loot ki taraf bheje hue aaye hain.
ayahs.71: Us ki biwi jo khadi hui thi woh hans padi, to hum ne use Ishaaq ki aur Ishaaq ke peechhe Yaqoob ki khushkhabri di.
ayahs.72: Woh kehne lagi haaye meri kam-bakhti! Mere haan aulaad kaise ho sakti hai main khud budhiya aur yeh mere khawind bhi bahut badi umr ke hain, yeh to yaqeenan badi ajeeb baat hai!
ayahs.73: Farishton ne kaha kya tu Allah ki qudrat se taajjub kar rahi hai? Tum par aye is ghar ke logo Allah ki rahmat aur is ki barakaten naazil hon, beshak Allah hamd-o-sana ka sazawaar aur badi shaan wala hai.
ayahs.74: Jab Ibraheem ka dar khauf jaata raha aur use bushaarat bhi pahunch chuki to hum se qaum-e-Loot ke baare mein kehne sunne lage.
ayahs.75: Yaqeenan Ibraheem bahut tahammul wale narm-dil aur Allah ki jaanib jhukne wale the.
ayahs.76: Aye Ibraheem! Is khayaal ko chhod dijiye, aap ke Rabb ka hukm aa pahuncha hai, aur un par na taale jaane wala azaab zaroor aane wala hai.
ayahs.77: Jab hamare bheje hue farishte Loot ke paas pahunche to woh un ki wajah se bahut ghamgeen ho gaye aur dil hi dil mein kadhne lage aur kehne lage ke aaj ka din badi museebat ka din hai.
ayahs.78: Aur is ki qaum daudti hui is ke paas aa pahunchi, woh to pehle hi se badkaariyon mein mubtala thi, Loot (alaihis salaam) ne kaha aye qaum ke logo! Yeh hain meri betiyan jo tumhare liye bahut hi paakeeza hain, Allah se daro aur mujhe mere mehmaanon ke baare mein ruswa na karo, kya tum mein ek bhi bhala aadmi nahin.
ayahs.79: Unhon ne jawab diya ke tu ba-khoobi jaanta hai ke hamein to teri betiyon par koi haq nahin hai aur tu hamari asli chaahat se ba-khoobi waaqif hai.
ayahs.80: Loot (alaihis salaam) ne kaha kaash ke mujh mein tum se muqabla karne ki quwwat hoti ya main kisi zabardast ka aasra pakad paata.
ayahs.81: Ab farishton ne kaha aye Loot! Hum tere parwardigar ke bheje hue hain, na-mumkin hai ke yeh tujh tak pahunch jaayen, pas tu apne ghar walon ko le kar kuchh raat rahe nikal khada ho. Tum mein se kisi ko mud kar bhi na dekhna chahiye, bajz teri biwi ke, is liye ke use bhi wahi pahunchne wala hai jo un sab ko pahunchega, yaqeenan un ke wade ka waqt subah ka hai, kya subah bilkul qareeb nahin.
ayahs.82: Phir jab hamara hukm aa pahuncha, hum ne is basti ko zer-o-zabar kar diya, oopar ka hissa neeche kar diya aur un par kankreele patthar barsaaye jo tah-ba-tah the.
ayahs.83: Tere Rabb ki taraf se nishaan-daar the aur woh in zaalimon se kuchh bhi door na the.
ayahs.84: Aur hum ne Madyan walon ki taraf un ke bhai Shoaib ko bheja, us ne kaha aye meri qaum! Allah ki ibaadat karo is ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin aur tum naap tol mein bhi kami na karo, main to tumhein aasooda-haal dekh raha hoon aur mujhe tum par ghirne wale din ke azaab ka khauf (bhi) hai.
ayahs.85: Aye meri qaum! Naap tol insaaf ke saath poori poori karo, logon ko un ki cheezen kam na do aur zameen mein fasaad aur kharaabi na machao.
ayahs.86: Allah Taala ka halaal kiya hua jo bach rahe tumhare liye bahut hi behtar hai agar tum imaan wale ho, main tum par kuchh nigehbaan (aur daroga) nahin hoon.
ayahs.87: Unhon ne jawab diya ke aye Shoaib! Kya teri salaat tujhe yehi hukm deti hai ke hum apne baap dadon ke mabudon ko chhod den aur hum apne maalon mein jo kuchh chahen is ka karna bhi chhod den, to tu bada hi ba-waqaar aur nek-chalan aadmi hai.
ayahs.88: Kaha aye meri qaum! Dekho to agar main apne Rabb ki taraf se raushan daleel liye hue hoon aur us ne mujhe apne paas se behtareen rozi de rakhi hai, mera yeh irada bilkul nahin ke tumhara khilaaf kar ke khud is cheez ki taraf jhuk jaun jis se tumhein rok raha hoon, mera irada to apni taaqat bhar islaah karne ka hi hai. Meri taufeeq Allah hi ki madad se hai, isi par mera bharosa hai aur isi ki taraf main rujoo karta hoon.
ayahs.89: Aur aye meri qaum (ke logo!) Kahin aisa na ho ke tum ko meri mukhaalifat un azaabon ka mustahiq bana de jo qaum-e-Nooh aur qaum-e-Hood aur qaum-e-Saleh ko pahunche hain. Aur qaum-e-Loot to tum se kuchh door nahin.
ayahs.90: Tum apne Rabb se istighfaar karo aur is ki taraf tauba karo, yaqeen mano ke mera Rabb badi mehrbani wala aur bahut mohabbat karne wala hai.
ayahs.91: Unhon ne kaha aye Shoaib! Teri aksar baaten to hamari samajh mein hi nahin aatin aur hum to tujhe apne andar bahut kamzor paate hain, agar tere qabeele ka khayaal na hota to hum to tujhe sangsaar kar dete, aur hum tujhe koi haisiyat wali hasti nahin ginte.
ayahs.92: Unhon ne jawab diya ke aye meri qaum ke logo! Kya tumhare nazdeek mere qabeele ke log Allah se bhi ziyada zi-izzat hain ke tum ne use pas-e-pusht daal diya hai, yaqeenan mera Rabb jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho sab ko ghere hue hai.
ayahs.93: Aye meri qaum ke logo! Ab tum apni jagah amal kiye jao main bhi amal kar raha hoon, tumhein anqareeb maloom ho jaayega ke kis ke paas woh azaab aata hai jo use ruswa kar de aur kaun hai jo jhoota hai. Tum intezaar karo main bhi tumhare saath muntazir hoon.
ayahs.94: Jab hamara hukm (azaab) aa pahuncha hum ne Shoaib ko aur un ke saath (tamaam) momino ko apni khaas rahmat se najaat bakhshi aur zaalimon ko sakht chinghaad ke azaab ne dhar dabocha jis se woh apne gharon mein aundhe pade hue ho gaye.
ayahs.95: Goya ke woh in gharon mein kabhi base hi na the, aagah raho Madyan ke liye bhi waisi hi doori ho jaisi doori Samood ko hui.
ayahs.96: Aur yaqeenan hum ne hi Moosa ko apni aayaat aur raushan daleelon ke saath bheja tha.
ayahs.97: Firaun aur is ke sardaron ki taraf, phir bhi in logon ne Firaun ke ahkaam ki pairwi ki aur Firaun ka koi hukm durust tha hi nahin.
ayahs.98: Woh to qayamat ke din apni qaum ka pesh-rau ho kar un sab ko dozakh mein ja khada karega, woh bahut hi bura ghaat hai jis par la khade kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.99: Un par to is dunya mein bhi lanat chipka di gayi aur qayamat ke din bhi bura inaam hai jo diya gaya.
ayahs.100: Bastiyon ki yeh baaz khabren jinhen hum tere saamne bayan farma rahe hain, in mein se baaz to maujood hain aur baaz (ki faslen) kat gayi hain.
ayahs.101: Hum ne un par koi zulm nahin kiya, balke khud unhon ne hi apne oopar zulm kiya, aur unhen un ke mabudon ne koi faaida na pahunchaaya jinhen woh Allah ke siwa pukaara karte the, jab ke tere parwardigar ka hukm aa pahuncha, balke aur un ka nuqsaan hi unhon ne badha diya.
ayahs.102: Tere parwardigar ki pakad ka yehi tareeqa hai jab ke woh bastiyon ke rehne wale zaalimon ko pakadta hai, beshak is ki pakad dukh dene wali aur nihaayat sakht hai.
ayahs.103: Yaqeenan is mein un logon ke liye nishaan-e-ibrat hai jo qayamat ke azaab se darte hain. Woh din jis mein sab log jama kiye jaayenge aur woh, woh din hai jis mein sab haazir kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.104: Use hum jo multawi karte hain woh sirf ek muddat-e-muayyan tak hai.
ayahs.105: Jis din woh aa jaayegi majaal na hogi ke Allah ki ijaazat ke baghair koi baat bhi kar le, so un mein koi bad-bakht hoga aur koi nek-bakht.
ayahs.106: Lekin jo bad-bakht hue woh dozakh mein honge, wahan cheekhenge chillaayenge.
ayahs.107: Woh wahin hamesha rehne wale hain jab tak aasman-o-zameen barqaraar rahen. Siwaye us waqt ke jo tumhara Rabb chahe. Yaqeenan tera Rabb jo kuchh chahe kar guzarta hai.
ayahs.108: Lekin jo nek-bakht kiye gaye woh jannat mein honge jahan hamesha rahenge jab tak aasman-o-zameen baaqi rahe magar jo tera parwardigar chahe. Yeh be-intiha bakhshish hai.
ayahs.109: Is liye aap in cheezon se shak-o-shubha mein na rahen jinhen yeh log poj rahe hain, un ki pooja to is tarah hai jis tarah un ke baap dadon ki is se pehle thi. Hum un sab ko un ka poora poora hissa baghair kisi kami ke dene wale hi hain.
ayahs.110: Yaqeenan hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko kitaab di. Phir is mein ikhtilaaf kiya gaya, agar pehle hi aap ke Rabb ki baat saadir na ho gayi hoti to yaqeenan un ka faisla kar diya jaata, unhen to is mein sakht shubha hai.
ayahs.111: Yaqeenan in mein se har ek jab un ke roo-ba-roo jaayega to aap ka Rabb use is ke aamaal ka poora poora badla dega. Beshak woh jo kar rahe hain in se woh ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.112: Pas aap jame rahiye jaisa ke aap ko hukm diya gaya hai aur woh log bhi jo aap ke saath tauba kar chuke hain, khabardaar tum hadd se na badhna, Allah tumhare tamaam aamaal ka dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.113: Dekho zaalimon ki taraf hargiz na jhukna warna tumhein bhi (dozakh ki) aag lag jaayegi aur Allah ke siwa aur tumhara madadgaar na khada ho sakega aur na tum madad diye jaoge.
ayahs.114: Din ke donon siron mein namaz barpa rakh aur raat ki kayi saaton mein bhi, yaqeenan nekiyan buraiyon ko door kar deti hain. Yeh naseehat hai naseehat pakadne walon ke liye.
ayahs.115: Aap sabr karte rahiye, yaqeenan Allah Taala neki karne walon ka ajr zaaya nahin karta.
ayahs.116: Pas kyun na tum se pehle zamane ke logon mein se aise ahl-e-khair log hue jo zameen mein fasaad phailaane se rokte, siwaye un chand ke jinhen hum ne un mein se najaat di thi, zaalim log to is cheez ke peechhe pad gaye jis mein unhen aasoodgi di gayi thi aur woh gunahgaar the.
ayahs.117: Aap ka Rabb aisa nahin ke kisi basti ko zulm se halaak kar de aur wahan ke log neko-kaar hon.
ayahs.118: Agar aap ka parwardigar chahta to sab logon ko ek hi raah par ek giroh kar deta. Woh to baraabar ikhtilaaf karne wale hi rahenge.
ayahs.119: Bajz un ke jin par aap ka Rabb rahm farmaaye, unhen to isi liye paida kiya hai, aur aap ke Rabb ki yeh baat poori hai ke main jahannam ko jinnon aur insaanon sab se pur karunga.
ayahs.120: Rasoolon ke sab ahwaal hum aap ke saamne aap ke dil ki taskeen ke liye bayan farma rahe hain. Aap ke paas is surat mein bhi haq pahunch chuka jo naseehat-o-waaz hai momino ke liye.
ayahs.121: Imaan na laane walon se keh dijiye ke tum apne taur par amal kiye jao, hum bhi amal mein mashghool hain.
ayahs.122: Aur tum bhi intezaar karo, hum bhi muntazir hain.
ayahs.123: Zameenon aur aasmanon ka ilm-e-ghaib Allah Taala hi ko hai, tamaam mamalaat ka rujoo bhi usi ki jaanib hai, pas tujhe usi ki ibaadat karni chahiye aur usi par bharosa rakhna chahiye aur tum jo kuchh karte ho is se Allah Taala be-khabar nahin.
